packageRules.description: Track @pfenerty/tektonic via its git tags (pinned as github:pfenerty/tektonic#vX.Y.Z in .tektonic/package.json). github-tags datasource; keep minor/patch automerge, hold majors for manual review + re-synth.

customManagers.description: Bump base/tool image tags in the tektonic TypeScript source (.tektonic/**/*.ts) in lockstep with the generated .tekton/ YAML, so re-synthesis never reverts a Renovate bump.
